title: Monday market brief
intro: Every Monday the agent reads the week's chip and AI news, pulls stock moves and writes a short brief. Press play to replay a run.
source: Sample run with illustrative numbers. Replace it with a real weekly run: python3 scripts/demos/record.py semiconductor

steps.label: Check API keys for unusual use
Pull the week's chip and AI news
Rank stories and link them to price moves
File in Notion and email it

result.title: This week in one minute
items: Memory makers led the week as AI servers kept pulling high-bandwidth memory supply.
Foundry capacity for leading-edge nodes stayed the main bottleneck for AI accelerators.
Hyperscalers reaffirmed capital spending plans, supporting chip equipment names.
PC and phone chip demand stayed soft, weighing on companies without an AI data-center story.

items.title: Micron (MU)
items.body: Pricing for high-bandwidth memory is the clearest read on AI server demand.

items.title: ASML (ASML)
items.body: Order commentary signals how fast foundries plan to add leading-edge capacity.

items.title: Arm (ARM)
items.body: Royalty growth from data-center chips is a second way to play AI build-outs.
